title: Install the app
intro: Set up a new phone in two steps: install the Android app, then connect it to this Rezeptplaner. Each device gets its own key; without a valid key, app access rejects every request.
copy_failed: Copying isn't possible – select the key and copy it.
revoke_confirm: Revoke key "{name}"? The device will no longer have access.
app_url_hint: Hostname in the Cloudflare tunnel that points to port 8100 (guide in docs/APP-ZUGANG.md). Enter once.
connect_scan: In the app, choose "Set up" and scan this code.
connect_gone: – after "Done" or when you leave the page it's gone (then just connect a new device).
qr_label: QR code for connecting the app
cf_hint: Only needed if the app hostname is protected by Cloudflare Access. The details only go into the QR code and are not saved.
save_url_first: Save the address for the app first.

install.recommended: Recommended via **Obtainium**: it installs Rezeptplaner and reports every update later. Scan the codes with the phone's camera.
install.qr_obtainium_add: QR code: add Rezeptplaner to Obtainium
install.apk_summary: Without Obtainium: download the APK directly
install.guide_auto_blocker: **Turn off Auto Blocker:** Settings → Security and privacy → Auto Blocker → Off. It blocks apps that don't come from the Play Store or Galaxy Store – including updates via Obtainium.
install.guide_unknown_apps: **Allow "Install unknown apps":** When you first open the downloaded file, Android asks whether the browser (or later Obtainium) may install apps → *Settings* → switch on → back.
install.guide_play_protect: **Confirm the Play Protect warning:** If Google Play Protect reports an "unknown app", tap *More details* → *Install anyway*. You can decline sending the app for a scan.
install.guide_open: Open Rezeptplaner and connect it in step 2.
install.skill_text: With the "rezeptplaner-import" skill, Claude captures recipes from photos (recipe cards, cookbook pages) and creates an import file that you share to the app or upload under Recipes → Import file.
install.skill_summary: How to add the skill to Claude
install.skill_step1: In Claude (claude.ai or the app), go to *Settings → Capabilities* and turn on "Code execution and file creation".
install.skill_step2: *Customize → Skills* → upload skill → choose the downloaded ZIP file (don't unzip it).
install.skill_step3: Send photos of the recipes in a chat, e.g. "Capture these recipes for Rezeptplaner". Claude returns a ZIP file to share.
install.skill_free: Also works with the free Claude plan, but larger batches of photos hit the usage limits sooner. When there's a new version of the skill, download the ZIP again and replace it in Claude.

scan.title: Scan QR code
scan.hint: Hold the recipe's QR code (e.g. on a printout) in front of the camera.
scan.denied: No camera access. Allow it in the browser – in the Home Assistant app the camera is often blocked here; paste the address instead.
scan.unavailable: Camera not available ({message}). Paste the address instead.
